reasons: The redline correctly replaces the walk-away language in 11.1 (immediate cessation of assistance, immediate permanent deletion, no export) with the playbook preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, including export/migration support.

Deletion is subordinated to Sections 11.2 and 11.3, preserving the existing compliant 30-day machine-readable return and certified-deletion mechanics rather than duplicating them — this is the smallest edit that reaches the playbook position.
The high changed-character ratio (0.861) is justified: the original sentence is directly contrary to the rule and cannot be salvaged by a partial edit, so a whole-clause replacement is appropriate.

The comment accurately identifies the walk-away issue and the internal contradiction with 11.2, 11.3 and 10.1, cites the playbook position, and offers the 90-day fallback in the required concise first-person-plural tone.
